deadline_text_verbatim: November 1: Early Decision and QuestBridge National College Match application deadline
limitations: QuestBridge National College Match has its own eligibility criteria (income/residency) set by QuestBridge, not independently verified against Columbia's own pages in this pass; recorded here only for the date, which Columbia's page states coincides with its Early Decision deadline.

deadline_text_verbatim: November 15: Early Decision financial aid application deadline
researcher_notes: Need-based institutional aid deadline, not a merit scholarship (Columbia has no merit scholarships). Covers CSS Profile submission; corroborated independently and exactly (same date) on the financial-aid subdomain's dedicated CSS Profile pages (https://cc-seas.financialaid.columbia.edu/content/27-28-css-profile-ed-international and https://cc-seas.financialaid.columbia.edu/content/27-28-css-profile-ed-domestic, both read 'Sunday, November 15, 2026'). Also covers FAFSA for domestic applicants per the 'Apply for Aid' hub page's bundled framing ('CSS Profile, FAFSA, taxes, etc.' due by the same round deadlines) -- see companion domestic-only record DL-2026-08-21-COL0006 for a FAFSA-specific row.

deadline_text_verbatim: February 15: Regular Decision financial aid application deadline
researcher_notes: Need-based institutional aid deadline, not a merit scholarship. Covers CSS Profile submission; corroborated independently and exactly (same date) on https://cc-seas.financialaid.columbia.edu/content/27-28-css-profile-rd-international and https://cc-seas.financialaid.columbia.edu/content/27-28-css-profile-rd-domestic, both read 'Monday, February 15, 2027.' Also covers FAFSA for domestic applicants -- see companion domestic-only record DL-2026-08-21-COL0007.

deadline_text_verbatim: [Financial aid application materials, including FAFSA,] due by the Early Decision financial aid application deadline of November 15
limitations: Columbia does not publish a FAFSA-specific date distinct from the general financial aid application deadline. The 'Apply for Aid' hub page states first-year applicants should refer to the How to Apply / Early Decision pages 'for instructions, deadlines and application materials (CSS Profile, FAFSA, taxes, etc.)' -- bundling FAFSA under the same Nov 15 / Feb 15 round deadlines without a separate FAFSA-only date. deadline_text_verbatim above is a researcher paraphrase combining that bundling statement with the Nov 15 date from DL-2026-08-21-COL0003, not a single verbatim sentence from the source.
researcher_notes: FAFSA (federal aid) applies to domestic applicants only (US citizens, permanent residents, certain eligible noncitizens) -- international students are not eligible for federal student aid ('as international students are not eligible for federal student aid, Columbia will meet all international financial aid with institutional resources,' https://undergrad.admissions.columbia.edu/apply/international/aid). Per research brief instruction, recorded as its own domestic-only row rather than as an international-applicant deadline.

deadline_text_verbatim: [Financial aid application materials, including FAFSA,] due by the Regular Decision financial aid application deadline of February 15
limitations: Same caveat as DL-2026-08-21-COL0006: no FAFSA-specific date is separately published; this reuses the general Regular Decision financial aid deadline under which FAFSA is bundled.
researcher_notes: See DL-2026-08-21-COL0006 for the FAFSA domestic-only rationale.

deadline_text_verbatim: Early Decision applicants have until the fourth Wednesday in November to submit their scores via their applicant status portal.
limitations: Weekday-of-month rule ('fourth Wednesday in November'), not an explicit calendar date; left null rather than computed to avoid a silent arithmetic error. For the 2026-2027 cycle this falls in November 2026.
researcher_notes: Applies only to applicants who initially answered 'no' to submitting ACT/SAT scores and later want to change that answer to 'yes,' under the current test-optional policy (REQ-2026-08-21-COL0001). They may change their answer only once.

deadline_text_verbatim: Regular Decision applicants must do so no later than January 15.
researcher_notes: Same test-optional answer-change rule as DL-2026-08-21-COL0012, Regular Decision track. February test-takers instead email ugrad-confirm@columbia.edu as soon as results are released (no fixed date given for that sub-case).
